description: Get a Stripe Checkout link to buy Developer credits (£10 each), for when a free trial or Developer account runs out (a 402 with insufficient_allowance). Show the link to the person: they choose how many and pay in their browser; you never handle payment details. Credits appear once Stripe confirms. A person can instead add a card on the billing page to be billed monthly for what they use. Not for Core, whose extra credits are billed automatically, or for subscribing to a plan.

inputSchema.description: A link to buy Developer credits at the API rate; the payer can change the quantity on Stripe's page.

credits.description: Credits to start with (Stripe's page lets the payer change it).

name: create_topup_link
